* Outbound calling is not available by default. Contact Support to enable this feature. All three plans share the same core capabilities. Tiers differ in commitment, included units, and overage rate.
No. You pay only for the conversations your agent actually handles.
Do spam calls cost me units?
No. Spam auto-disconnected within 30 seconds, immediate hang-ups, and calls that never connect all cost nothing.
How much is a unit worth in real usage?

Roughly one voice call or about 30 text messages. A voice session between 30 seconds and 3 minutes is one unit, a session of 30 seconds or less is 0.2 units, and longer calls bill in 3-minute increments. A text session of up to 15 agent messages is 0.5 units, plus 0.5 for each further 15.
No. Voice and text draw from one shared balance that resets each billing cycle. The 50 free units on Pay As You Go are the exception: they are granted once per account and do not expire.
Can one plan cover several locations?
No. A plan covers one agent at one location and cannot be split across agents or locations. Multi-location businesses are handled on Enterprise, priced at the organization level.
Am I locked into a contract?
No. Billing is monthly with no long-term lock-in, and cancellation takes effect immediately. Lower effective rates come only from an annual commitment or a promotion.
In local currency. EUR and GBP have their own price books with their own rates rather than a currency conversion of the USD price.
